Implement P01/P02 and L01/S03 portable responsibilities alongside K01–K05: tagged domain codecs, source catalog/coverage, scoped selection/repositories, location correction/session/outlier/outing algorithms, usage bucket/session/device/title models and reducers, explicit cross-domain association, and independently versioned summary/record/archive planning. C14–C17 fixtures cover exact source precision, corrections/deletions, overlap/replacement, aggregate boundaries, title escaping/redaction, source/destination admission and migration identity.

Keep these inside the same portable package and operation catalog. A location ExportKit adapter, Swift usage CLI analytics implementation or mobile TypeScript exporter may supply source evidence, but none remains a second permanent business authority after qualification. Native durable capture/storage, entitlement/report views and privileged OS calls remain host interfaces. Retain golden source fixtures plus independent invariants rather than using a new implementation to approve its own outputs.

normative_protocol: These are planning proposals for private metadata/one transaction per child. Each child first freezes complete exact closed command/plan/receipt union and full literal grammar/ports/budgets BEFORE source/test implementation; this packet never authorizes coding directly.

TrustedPorts is the exact child-specific coarse catalog/source/store/current adapter set captured once at constructor; no caller Layer/object/function can supply grants/source classification/frontier. Every primitive request is bounded before properties/coercion; own WeakMap context/factory/command/snapshot/plan/ticket/receipt membership precedes properties, including foreign/revoked Proxy request with an authentic own ticket.

Register captured original Scope sentinel and reusable closed signal BEFORE first trusted callback. Scope finalizer expires/signals without joining the same callback; operation bracket interrupts only its own interruptible preparation/read/use, waits registered/partial cleanup ACK, never races/drops release. Busy until ACK or cleanup poison; external Scopeclose completion is not storage/resource ACK.

AuthorizedSourceView.read is lazy Effect-valued. EACH execution checks current source/purpose/detail/destination/latest external suppression before materialization, then rechecks original Scope/member/context/actual callback after await before raw slice with no intervening yield. Callback inner ensuring expires views/issuers immediately when actual port Effect exits BEFORE postcurrent/releaseACK; outer ensuring backstop required.

CommitHost is a trusted transactional capability, not an ordinary unknown acquire result. Its interruptible resource-free prepare plus finite synchronous completed registration and scoped exact-once ACK must be independently frozen. Protected commit disposition/release cannot hide unbounded pending acquisition. Partial-resource cleanup/native deadline proof remains a later host requirement.

Core computes one owned mutation plan; host performs storage/atomic application only. Host independently checks authoritative current suppression/source grant at its actual commit linearization, not caller boolean or async check followed by unguarded commit. Synthetic host makes this an explicit fake atomic guard, not proof that a real backend can atomically consult an external journal.

Result decisions committed/definitely_not_committed/ambiguous survive caller interruption in the trusted fake ledger. No automatic retry of ambiguous commitment, no claimed rollback after possible commit, no receipt success before cleanupACK and captured current/originalScope assertion. Cleanup failure poisons and takes precedence; actual external interruption before terminal precedes original closed.

One logical dataset does not require copying native health stores into a new cache. Source partition/schema/profile/detail kinds stay independent; source snapshots/checkpoints per source, no globally atomic cross-device snapshot or source hash authentication.

Identity tuple retains dataset/source contract/device/install known or unknown/native namespace/original identity/revision. Imported identity uses immutable artifact/original logical partition/ordinal, not transport page/path/date; no concatenation collision or canonical-projection-only equality. Same key exact eligible field-vector equal is replay; different vector conflict. Actual full source grammar/archive equality owner remains explicit.

Private proposed guard budgets:65536 UTF8 command/record,1048576 page or staged batch,4096 records,512 selectors,one in-flight transaction. Stage1 must independently freeze boundary+1/depth/nodes/raw canonical token/surrogate/decoded-key policy. No public source restrictions or retention window arise from these unmeasured caps; large history partitions/paging remain later owner.
